The available evidence for this topic is thin, consisting of only two claims and one related entity. It focuses entirely on the evaluation of [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] within the AKDB 2024 report. 

The evaluation reveals that the specific development target of achieving a result of 90% or higher is far from being met [^src1]. Furthermore, the assessment highlights a complete failure across all participating organizations, noting that none of the reporting units managed to fulfill this development target [^src1]. No further details, chronological events, or additional related entities are available in the provided corpus.

## Claims

**Source: AKDB_2024.pdf, pages 21-25**
*Page 21*
- Udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 % er således langt fra opfyldt [^src1] (indikator-3)
- Ingen af de indberettende enheder opfyldte udviklingsmålet [^src1] (indikator-3)
